aesthetic: Marginalia Moderna — Swiss-inflected academic journal where asymmetric column ratios and restrained vermillion accents evoke the controlled tension of a peer-reviewed broadsheet
chromaticArc: Opens on navy signal, immediately lifts to parchment ground for 10+ body slides, touches linen wash at the first methodological pivot, returns to parchment through the core argument, drops to navy for one mid-deck divider, resurfaces through alternating parchment and linen, and closes on a final navy signal — three light-dark crossings total.
gridStrategy: Title zones lock to a narrow 15-column rail (col 0–14 or col 45–59) while body zones claim the remaining 40 columns, with the rail flipping sides every 4–6 slides to prevent visual fatigue; divider slides break the pattern with full-width centred titles.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Palatino used for all body text, blockquotes, and extended prose; Futura reserved exclusively for headings, labels, and navigational elements

accentStrategy: Thin 1px vermillion horizontal rules appear on ~65% of slides as zone dividers between title and body rails; on divider slides the accent becomes a 3-column vertical bar spanning the full grid height.
